method: Play-mode isolated PhysicsScene2D. Invoke the production WorldRotator.FixedUpdate, then simulate only the local physics scene. Each request is a separate actual simulation step; no game PlayerLoop frame or fixture Start runs.

results.name: Default root motion stays within 120 degrees per second
results.detail: SetTargetAngle must defer movement; each sample follows a real local simulation. Expected saturated step=2.399999

results.name: Large target is consumed in actual steps of at most three degrees
results.detail: SetTargetAngle must defer movement; each sample follows a real local simulation. Expected saturated step=3

results.name: Latest absolute target replaces the previous target
results.detail: A new angle-mode target reverses immediately instead of appending an old target to a queue.

results.name: Rate input backlog is bounded
results.detail: 100 queued rate-input bursts remain within the configured input-lag budget of 30 degrees.

results.name: Rate input expires after release even when geometry slows rotation
results.detail: Age the last nonzero rate sample beyond its configured lifetime. Stale rate input must stop; a new absolute target must still move.

results.name: Configured composite / identity pose
results.detail: Composite retains generated geometry and follows an absolute root-relative body pose. Root scale=(1.00, 1.00); explicitly configured=True

results.name: Configured composite / translated rotated nonuniform root
results.detail: Composite retains generated geometry and follows an absolute root-relative body pose. Root scale=(1.80, 0.70); explicitly configured=True

results.name: Legacy Static composite is automatically made Kinematic
results.detail: Composite retains generated geometry and follows an absolute root-relative body pose. Root scale=(0.80, 1.40); explicitly configured=False

results.name: Pause clears pending movement without resume catch-up
results.detail: Pending root and attached Composite movement must be discarded rather than replayed after the gate opens.
